name: manticore
_about: SCULPTED (2026-11-05, docs/engines.md 'the sculpt overlay'): a lion's body -- the lion's own rig and shapes (mammals/lion.json) scaled from its .95 to .9 -- in cinnabar red, the mane in the lion's fleece, darker; a dragon's bat wings at the withers (dragons.js dragonBatWing, as rig parts: four finger bones drawn by the body, the skin ONE membrane a wing (2026-11-08, tools/creaturegen/var/isl/mantwing.py): a single sheet, every vertex shared -- on a finger or between two by its angle, the arm's panel between the root line on the flank (bone wRootL, the body's frame aloft, folded up against the flank at rest) and the last finger -- so no seam can open; its outline the old plates', the scalloped trailing edge; @mem, lighter toward @memIn in the arm panel's middle), folded up and back over the rump at rest and spread aloft by flyRot; THE ARM drawn (2026-11-08, tools/creaturegen/var/isl/mantarm.py): the elbow moved onto the skin's leading edge (it sat 16 cm inside the skin, behind it), the hand's frames kept, and the humerus, the forearm and the thumb's hooked claw sharp `horn`s on their own bones -- details, never in the body's field -- so the arm runs visibly along the leading edge aloft, shoulder to elbow to wrist, without pulling the body's skin after it; and for a tail a scorpion's, on a path of tubes from the croup arching up and forward over the hindquarters (clear of a rider), drawn as seven glossy knobbed segments, the bulbous vesicle and the aculeus curving forward and down (2026-11-08, ears2.py) The EARS (ears2.py): round cupped sheets (sharp.js `fin`), dark edged, cream in the hollow; the roots faired. WHISKERS (2026-11-08, tools/creaturegen/sharp/whiskers.py): 16 ivory whiskers a side, 4 rows on the whisker pad (120-179 mm); 3 ivory whiskers a side, a brow tuft (44-60 mm) -- `whiskers` shapes (bodyspec.js whiskerStrands: thin pointed strands, mirrored, on the head, near mesh only; details, so every coat and variant still shares one mesh).
